downloads.boost.warningText: Telegram gives this speed to Premium only. With the boost the server may limit transfers for a while (flood wait), and they will wait. If that happens, turn the boost off.
downloads.menu.boostFooter: More parts of a file at once and larger parts — what Telegram gives Premium. The server may answer with a limit (flood wait); the transfer then waits. Files under 1 MB are not boosted.
downloads.menu.galleryFooter: Items of the “…” menu of photos and videos. They are not shown in chats with copy protection and in secret chats.
downloads.menu.largePhotosInfo: Compressed photos up to 2560 px on the long side instead of 1280
downloads.menu.photosFooter: Quality is the JPEG compression of outgoing photos and story photos. “As in Telegram”: 60% for photos, 70% for stories.
downloads.menu.statusFooter: While a file downloads, the chat’s row shows the file name and a progress bar instead of the preview, and the chat shows a bar under its title; tapping it opens the message.
